groups.boundary: An interrupted storage mutation or backup must not bypass durable accounting or restore quarantine.
groups.finding: Public compact owns BEGIN IMMEDIATE; auto compaction uses its submission writer transaction. Summary update precedes dependent deletion; failed deletion unwinds the whole transaction. Deletion order respects trap/edge and hop/resource dependencies. Schema9 indexes and columns follow schema8 and preserve the prior migrations. Backup code continues to set quarantine.
groups.secondary_evidence: Author reports16 native cases including a SQLite-triggered atomic rollback, genuine bounded quotas, a synthetic schema8 downgrade fixture, threaded compactors, and backup E_RESTORE_QUARANTINED. Independently performed actual schema8 producer upgrades complement those authored tests.

groups.boundary: Compaction must preserve immutable snapshots/evidence, deletion/publication/site restrictions and original acceptance gates.
groups.finding: Retention table deletion set contains only task details and eligible robots. Private canonical bodies/evidence and all watermarks are outside it.
groups.direct_evidence: Existing import snapshot, its evidence quote and a completed read snapshot remain byte-identical through real schema upgrade, compaction and reopen.
groups.limitation: Publication race and frozen-policy behavior are covered by the prior Stage1 independent report plus author/root integration gates, not re-certified by this retention harness.

author_report_separate.reported_at_review: 16 retention native scenarios passed in2.50s; no independent full native rerun by reviewer. Exact final suite assertion counts and whole-tree gating belong to root execution records.

limitations: No true HTTP, subprocess-crash, sanitizer or target Windows test was performed by this review. Root must execute and bind the integrated source tree gates.

Compaction is a finite permanent-key ledger with detail reclamation; it is not unbounded lifetime operation. owner10000/global50000 can still be reached, and legacy databases already exceeding new caps are not silently purged.
The seven-day cutoff uses created_at, deadline and lease_until. Aged paused/queued/unsettled work is not forcibly made terminal by compact_jobs. Ordinary settlement/control remains necessary.
DELETE releases logical row capacity and SQLite reusable pages. It does not promise an immediate filesystem size reduction or run VACUUM.
Native core limit/accounting and authorization boundaries are reviewed here; the separate CLI/MCP adapter is outside this report.

The maintained execution order after integration is schema8 refresh fences, schema9 retention, schema10 fairness and schema11 sessions. The root must remap isolated branch migration numbers and include new native targets in Windows/ASan gates.

The original83 packages,161 acceptance mappings and10 slices are preserved. This review grants no package acceptance and fabricates no human labels, independent source approval, S0 result or backup restore certification.
